init_renderer: create a Pytorch3dRenderer instance with a given image size and mesh color for 3D mesh rendering
render_mesh: render 3D mesh vertices and faces onto a background image using the Pytorch3dRenderer render method
get_renderer_internal: build a MeshRenderer with FoVOrthographicCameras, rasterization settings, and SoftPhongShader for a given render size
review_renderer_config: review the Pytorch3dRenderer class to understand the three renderer sizes: small (200), medium (400), and large (700)
refactor_render_method: refactor the render method to customize bounding box padding margin or vertex normalization logic
